6,934 likes, 604 comments - yourfoodlab on October 8, 2026: "If there’s one dish from Uttarakhand that instantly feels like home to me, it has to be Aloo Ke Gutke ❤️

It’s such a simple dish, but the freshly ground spices and those perfectly cooked potatoes make it incredibly comforting. I love having it with hot, fluffy puris and a bowl of cool raita, honestly, this is the kind of meal I can never say no to!

And if you love cooking with freshly ground spices like I do, our Silver Masala Dani is such a beautiful addition to the kitchen ✨ Available at the best price right now 🛍️

Happy Cooking! ❤️ Comment “Masala Dani” and ill send you the link 😍".
